answer_1.quote: Prior work in NLP has shown the ability of LMs to simulate personas and social interactions. A few recent works leverage this capability by using LMs to help people improve interpersonal skills or conflict resolution skills...
answer_1.outputs: conversational responses, skill suggestions, feedback text

answer_2.quote: Moreover, we conduct a secondary evaluation using automatic metrics, ROUGE-L and BertScore and find that our model is competitive on both metrics...

answer_4.quote: In our human evaluation, we recruit CS PhD students who are familiar with LM generations. The task is to identify if the model-generated feedback is the same as expert-generated feedback.
answer_4.guideline: The participants are guided by the rubric below: 1). Think about if you received the feedback, would you have acted the same, or differently? 2). Do they give the same reason of why the utterance should be improved? 3). Do not think about whether they are equally specific or actionable.
